profile_text.body:
Coursera is a public company, traded as COUR, founded in 2012 and headquartered in Mountain View, California. Its site describes it as offering online courses, Professional Certificates, Specializations, and degrees from universities and companies including Google, Meta, Anthropic, DeepLearning.AI, Stanford, and IBM. It also describes Coursera Plus as an annual subscription giving learners unlimited access to thousands of courses, Specializations, and Professional Certificates.

The site places AI among its main subject areas, alongside data science, cybersecurity, and software engineering. Named programs include the Machine Learning Specialization, the Deep Learning Specialization, the AI Essentials Specialization, and the AI Engineer Professional Certificate, and the site says some learners begin with beginner-friendly Python or generative AI courses. Other programs it names include the Google Cybersecurity Professional Certificate, the Google Project Management Professional Certificate, the Google UX Design Professional Certificate, the IBM Data Science Professional Certificate, the IBM Data Analyst Professional Certificate, the Data Analysis with Python Specialization, and the UI/UX Design Specialization. Coursera describes its certificates as providing job-ready skills and a verifiable credential, and says its Professional Certificates and Specializations are designed in collaboration with employers and universities.

Company records list Coursera as a for-profit public company with SEC CIK 0001651562. Its litigation record lists 237 matters in California.
